ways.name: Make the running work its own observation surface
ways.problem: The usual workflow puts the agent outside the process: wait for completion, inspect a summary, repair the visible result, declare success; learning starts after the state has gone cold.
ways.invariant: Every live system exposes a named observation surface, the responsible agent reads it while the system runs, at least one observation changes the next intervention, and the attachment is kept as machinery with a ratchet.

ways.name: Nothing is accepted on say-so
ways.problem: An assertion severed from its derivation cannot be checked, learned from, or recovered.
ways.invariant: Every reviewed change carries a warrant whose shas match the diff; a run without one is the dirty tree, not a veto.

ways.name: Everything that exists is on the map, or it is a hole
ways.problem: Knowing what exists and its state, with provenance, at stack scale.
ways.invariant: Every hyperedge section reads OK and the five standards (regenerates, evidence, reconstitution, honest holes, composed) hold. A sixth, readability: a reader holding only the page answers sampled done-or-not-done questions correctly (claude-16's proposal; Joe 2026-11-02 said he cannot keep a picture of the whole stack).
ways.scope-note: s1-s5 test that the map regenerates and carries evidence, not that it can be read; s6 readability is failing on Joe's own statement today and has no sampled-question test yet; a second measure for s6 (claude-16 from Joe's remark): a reader holding only the page can reach a point and rebuild its context; same sampled test, a fresh agent first and Joe second

ways.name: A send is not a receipt
ways.problem: The loop's human and stakeholder edges are where learning silently dies.
ways.invariant: Every bell has a return path and every reply to the operator carries intent marks that can be read back.
ways.scope-note: the planned probe over Agency bell/park/bellback records covers agents only; a holding reading must not be taken as feedback reaching people (claude-16, 2026-11-02); people and outside value get a separate way of working (real-users), shape here, values in futon7

ways.name: A selection gives a reason over ways of selecting, and a click can be refused
ways.problem: Deciding what to do next, accountably, under uncertainty, with the goals themselves formable.
ways.invariant: No outer-then-inner click runs unless the selection report names the way of selecting that won and what it would have proposed otherwise.
ways.validation: Does the selection report name the way of selecting that won, and what the alternatives would have proposed? A probe can also count the eligible items the selector read (M-giraffe finding 1: a pick from items never read).

ways.name: All files are committed and pushed; no mess is left in the repos
ways.problem: Uncommitted and unpushed work is invisible to every other participant, cannot be reviewed, and is lost on the next disk failure; a dirty tree also stops the click loop's preflight.
ways.invariant: Every repo under ~/code with an upstream has no untracked or modified files and no unpushed commits.
built: futon3/inbox-zero-lib (turn-end promotion in the futon3c JVM)

ways.name: Every open item is placed under a way of working, or declared retired
ways.problem: Thousands of backlogged items that nobody has read are a pile, not a plan; neither the operator nor the War Machine can select from a pile.
ways.invariant: The draw pile is empty: every mission, excursion and ticket on the stack has a placement (wing, action, finish) or a retirement, and the placements are on a committed path.

ways.name: All operator turns are logged to the evidence landscape
ways.problem: Without the operator's turns in the record, nothing an agent did can be traced to what was asked.
ways.invariant: Every operator turn appears in the evidence landscape (Joe 2026-08-28: the fundamental invariant; everything else builds from it).

ways.name: The work has real users, and we can say who
ways.problem: A community is a claim until it names a population: a thing used by people, known at a date, from a source that is not our own say-so. Building feels like progress, and a population is easy to assume.
ways.invariant: Each population holds a dated, sourced value on the scale none, asked, tried, uses, depends, with hops from the source recorded as a plain fact.
ways.declared-in: futon3/library/ways-of-working/real-users.flexiarg (claude-16, draft 2026-11-02); values, populations and contacts stay in futon7/holes/cui-bono.md and are not published here
ways.shape: real-users(population, thing, hops) -> value in {none, asked, tried, uses, depends}, dated, sourced
ways.scope-note: hand reading, Joe 2026-11-02: two collaborators, outreach under way; not derived from records, and not zero; only the fluent's shape is published; no monitor state is claimed and no named population appears on the page

ways.name: What was asked stays open until it is met or withdrawn
ways.problem: Intents are spoken in turns and then live only in the operator's head, so work that misses them is caught only if he notices.
ways.invariant: Each operator intent is a tracked act, and work that does not match it can be noticed, flagged, revoked or reworked.

ways.name: The work stays alive and paid for
ways.problem: Every other way depends on machines, history and money that can stop.
ways.invariant: Bills are paid, a verified off-box copy of the evidence exists, failures reach the operator unasked, and runway is known.
